subject.statement: Trevor Milton is currently serving a prison sentence for fraud.

summary: The claim that Trevor Milton is currently serving a prison sentence for fraud is false. Although he was convicted of securities and wire fraud in 2022‑2023 and sentenced to four years in prison, he received a full pardon from President Donald Trump in March 2025, which vacated his incarceration. Since the pardon, Milton has remained free on bail pending appeal and is not listed as an inmate in any federal or state prison system. Consequently, there is no official confirmation that he is presently incarcerated for fraud.

findings.statement: Trevor Milton was convicted of securities and wire fraud in October 2022 and sentenced in December 2023 to four years in prison.
In March 2025, Trevor Milton received a full and unconditional pardon from President Donald Trump, which vacated his prison sentence.
After sentencing, Trevor Milton remained free on bail pending appeal and, following the pardon, has not been incarcerated for fraud.
No federal or state inmate locator (BOP or state DOC) lists Trevor Milton as a current inmate for a fraud‑related offense; sources indicate he is not incarcerated.
Based on the original December 2023 four‑year sentence, the projected release date would have been December 2027, but the March 2025 pardon altered that outcome.

gaps: No direct query of the Federal Bureau of Prisons inmate locator or state Department of Corrections databases was presented in the evidence.
The evidence does not include a contemporaneous DOJ press release or official pardon proclamation document.
There is no real‑time verification (as of the exact date of analysis) that Milton’s pardon has been processed in all relevant federal systems.
